title: Poplar Street Tract
summary: An ideal 2.5± acre custom homesite on Poplar Street, minutes from downtown Monroe and about 35 minutes from Athens.
bullets: 2.5± acres located on Poplar Street in Monroe, GA
Less than 10 minutes from downtown Monroe
Ideal lot for a custom-built home
directions: From downtown Monroe, head out on E Church Street and continue for approximately 1.5 miles. Then turn onto Poplar Street. When you reach the stop sign, continue left and drive for about 1 mile. The property will be located on your right-hand side.
